measured.conclusion: more sockets awaiting drain than the entire dynamic range, so fresh loopback connections can be refused

not_the_cause: product code does not bind a fixed port; the client is refused before a connection exists

tried.bounded accept (kept): turned the infinite hang into a fast failure
tried.pre-flight loopback probe to skip: rejected - the probe can succeed while the real connect still fails, so it would skip or fail unpredictably
